# A square draft just short of its apex

The base is a side-4 square. The inset and axial height are both
2 − 10⁻⁸ at 45°, so the upper square's side is about 2 × 10⁻⁸.
The desired measures follow the frustum formulas from
`tapers/square-draft`.

`oracle.json` records `program.py` through CadQuery 2.3.0 and Open
CASCADE 7.9.3.0. The oracle accepts the pyramid in the collapse
limit. Arris 0.12.0 refuses the short edges in the upper profile.
